context.purpose: Compute frozen-composition ideal-gas properties or TP/HP equilibrium sweeps for the ten-species hydrogen/oxygen h2o2 mechanism; export independently checked numeric state tables.
context.assumptions: Isolated Cantera 3.2.x Python with the qualified h2o2.yaml SHA256. Only ideal-gas ohmech phase. SI K, Pa, kg, J; composition amounts are explicitly mole or mass basis and normalised.
context.constraints: Two nodes, 2–100 independent temperature samples, 300–3500 K initial and final temperatures, 1000–10000000 Pa. H2,H,O,O2,OH,H2O,HO2,H2O2,AR,N2 only. N2/Ar are inert; no NOx, carbon, condensed phases, kinetics, transport or ignition delay.
context.inspection: Read results.csv with numeric columns including units and X_/Y_ species fractions. chemistry-summary.json explains mechanism hash, phase, input basis and independent element/equilibrium residuals. Keep both when handing the table to Calc.
context.recovery: INVALID_COMPOSITION needs distinct supported species and positive total amount. INTERPRETER_NOT_FOUND needs a configured Cantera Python. A changed mechanism needs explicit requalification. HP states outside 300–3500 K fail verification; choose a supported initial state/composition. Native failures retain logs; use a fresh directory after correcting input.

workflow.scope: Verified numeric results.csv into Calc readCSV; preserve chemistry-summary.json for units, species and mechanism limits. Unchanged Cantera and workbook attempts can be reused.

composition.scope: Shared document references, pure value functions and expressions resolve for every finite analytic visit before native validation.

lifecycle.timeout: One total deadline bounds build and fresh-process CSV reopen. Kit watchdog independently bounds the entire attempt.
lifecycle.cancellation: Shared owned native process cancellation; final cancellation check precedes publication.
lifecycle.logs: authored.json, plan.json, built/reopened native records, captured mechanism bytes/hash, worker source, stage stdout/stderr, CSV, summary and incomplete/failure results remain in each fresh attempt.
lifecycle.verification: Pure host NASA7/ideal-gas formulas verify all thermodynamic properties, normalised mass/mole fractions and element inventories. Equilibrium checks all accessible species chemical potentials against element potentials; TP holds T/P, HP holds enthalpy/P. A second Cantera process reloads the saved CSV states. No success flag substitutes for numerical checks.

cases.scope: Monatomic ideal argon: cp=5R/(2M), cv=3R/(2M), rho=PM/(RT), h=5R(T-298.15)/(2M), X_AR=Y_AR=1. Independent literal analytic expectations.
Doubling pressure doubles ideal argon density; cp remains 5R/(2M).
Fixed T/P and normalised mass fractions are literal; independent host NASA7 chemical potentials prove equilibrium with conserved element inventories on every row.
Adiabatic equilibrium conserves initial specific enthalpy and elemental moles per kg; host NASA7 and chemical-potential checks apply to all rows. Literal initial T/P prevent a successful wrong sweep.
Independent analytic H2 dissociation extent from NASA7 Kp: alpha=sqrt(Kp/(4P/P0+Kp)), X_H=2alpha/(1+alpha). No native result is used for this expectation.
Mass amounts equal molecular weights give equimolar H2/O2 with X_H2=X_O2=0.5 and Y_H2=2.016/(2.016+31.998), at both temperature limits and the NASA7 range boundary.
